sections.Profile:
Playmatic released two closely related pinball machines, "Fairy" (1975) and "Fantasy" (1976), both of which share a nearly identical playfield layout and gameplay features. "Fairy" is a single-player electro-mechanical game featuring two flippers, one pop bumper, two slingshots, seven standup targets, six rollover buttons, a spinning target, a kick-out hole, a captive ball, and an action ring. "Fantasy" is the four-player version of "Fairy, allowing for multiplayer gameplay while retaining the same engaging features.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1975–1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
